## Changes

- Process user steering while the model is responding. Preserve queued follow-ups, compaction, and completed tool results.
- Yield running Python calls with a retrievable cell ID. Pause before another host call and resume without replaying completed effects.
- Keep Python output previews small, retain the beginning and ending, and save larger results for paged retrieval after session restore.
- Expand images to the available panel width and up to 75% of terminal height. Resize with panels and fit narrow terminals.

- Keep running, paused, failed, and historical code results distinct in tool details. Retain streamed previews and restore bounded nested-call metadata.
- Delay child completion until its detached call and checkpoint are safe. Report deferred edits once through pi-subagent 0.5.32, with no automatic script continuation.

## Verification

Offline integration tests cover the packaged Pi runtime, accepted input, running Python calls, resumable state, and saved output. Provider cancellation tests check stale connection state and late events. Image render tests cover expansion, panel resizing, and narrow screens.
